description: This file defines a Perl module named 'metadata' that contains functions and data structures for parsing and handling package, target, and metadata information related to a software project. It includes subroutines for reading package metadata, target metadata, and package manifest metadata, as well as managing external references and symbols.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiple lines from a file handle until a line starting with '@@' is encountered; returns the accumulated string.

methods.name: confstr
methods.description: Transforms a configuration string by replacing certain characters with underscores for standardization.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata_usergroup
methods.description: Parses specifications for user or group metadata, validating IDs and names, and storing them in provided hashes.

methods.name: parse_target_metadata
methods.description: Reads a target metadata file, extracting information about build targets, profiles, dependencies, and attributes, returning structured data about each target.

methods.name: clear_packages
methods.description: Resets package-related hashes to empty, clearing cached data.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Parses a package metadata file, populating global hashes with package, source, override, and category information.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Reads a package manifest file, extracting package info such as version, dependencies, source, license, and size for each package.
